title: Phase 3 (Frontend): Fix storefront product fetch error/empty states + admin products list correctness + verification checklist

requirements.summary: Distinguish empty catalog vs failed fetch on storefront and remove the old user-visible fetch error message.
acceptanceCriteria: When product fetch fails (e.g., canister/network error), show a toast with exact text: "Failed to load products. Try refreshing."
When the fetch succeeds but returns zero products, do not show the fetch-failed toast; instead show an empty state with the exact headline text: "No products yet — add in admin panel".
Storefront pages that depend on products (at minimum collections/category listing experiences that use `useGetAllProducts`) do not render blank screens or crash in either empty or error scenarios.
The old error presentation "Could not fetch products from the backend" is not shown to users in the normal UI flow.

file_operations.description: Update product listing rendering to handle React Query error vs empty-catalog states explicitly (error card + retry action vs premium empty state), and ensure no blank screen/crash. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update collections/category listing rendering to handle React Query error vs empty-catalog states explicitly (error card + retry action vs premium empty state), and ensure no blank screen/crash. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Extend/adjust the empty-state component to support the Phase 3 copy and styling (gold headline text) and optional admin CTA slot. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a premium dark-luxury error state component for product fetch failures, with a retry action and styling consistent with existing theme utilities (gold hover/glow). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update useGetAllProducts to surface fetch failures via React Query error state and show a single premium toast per failure event.
acceptanceCriteria: On fetch failure, `useGetAllProducts` results in React Query error state (`isError`/`error`) rather than only returning an empty list.
On fetch failure, the toast with exact text "Failed to load products. Try refreshing." is shown once per failure event (no toast spam loops).
On success with zero products, `useGetAllProducts` is not in error state and returns an empty array.

file_operations.description: Refactor `useGetAllProducts` to remove the current catch-and-return-empty behavior, allowing errors to propagate into React Query error state; implement a non-spammy toast side effect with exact copy "Failed to load products. Try refreshing." and remove the old "Could not fetch products from the backend" messaging. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement premium empty-state UI for empty product catalog on collections/category pages, including an admin-only CTA to the admin products route.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty catalog state displays the exact text: "No products yet — add in admin panel".
The empty state matches the existing dark luxury theme, using gold-accent typography for the headline and premium card styling consistent with the app.
If and only if the user is recognized as an admin using the app’s existing admin detection approach (consistent with current admin gating logic), a visible pearl-blue button is rendered.
The admin CTA button navigates via SPA navigation to the admin products page route (existing admin route), without a full page reload.
If the user is not an admin, the admin CTA is not shown.

file_operations.description: Add props/variants to render the exact Phase 3 headline text in gold-accent styling and optionally render an admin CTA button with pearl-blue styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small client-side helper that mirrors the existing admin detection approach (based on the current Internet Identity principal and the admin principal constant) to decide whether to show the admin-only CTA. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the empty-state variant into the main storefront collections section; when admin is detected, show CTA that SPA-navigates to the existing admin products route. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the empty-state variant into collections/category pages; when admin is detected, show CTA that SPA-navigates to the existing admin products route. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure admin products list reflects persisted backend state and supports edit/delete actions with immediate UI updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin products list loads products from the backend (`adminListProducts`) and reflects the canister’s persisted state.
Delete action calls the backend delete API and the product disappears from the list without requiring a manual reload.
After deleting a product, refreshing the page does not bring it back (it is removed from canister persistence).
Edit action updates the persisted product and the updated values are visible after refresh in both admin list and storefront listings (when applicable).

file_operations.description: Harden admin product list refresh/invalidation behavior so the list stays in sync after create/update/delete and errors are handled without forcing full-page reloads. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update admin list retry/error UI to avoid full reload where possible (prefer provider refresh) and ensure delete/edit actions keep premium styling and remain responsive. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Retain premium dark-luxury styling and golden hover/glow interactions across Phase 3 UI changes while staying responsive and crash-free.
acceptanceCriteria: New/modified buttons added for Phase 3 have a gold hover/glow treatment consistent with existing styling utilities/classes.
All Phase 3-touched pages remain usable on mobile and desktop widths (no layout breakage or overflow causing horizontal scroll bugs).
No blank screen occurs when navigating to collections/category pages with empty catalog or when backend fetch fails.
No routing/authentication flow changes are introduced beyond linking to existing admin routes.

Implement the error-state component with dark-luxury card styling, gold hover/glow on retry, and responsive spacing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the new empty/error state integration preserves the dark-luxury theme and remains responsive (no overflow/blank screens). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure Phase 3-touched admin list actions (retry/delete/edit) keep premium hover/glow interactions and mobile-friendly layout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add Phase 3 post-deploy verification checklist to project documentation/release notes flow.
acceptanceCriteria: A post-deploy checklist is provided confirming: (1) products fetch from backend without the prior "Could not fetch" user-visible error, (2) persistence across reload, (3) admin list shows edit/delete, (4) UI remains stable/responsive.
The draft/live URL is provided after deployment.

Add a Phase 3 entry referencing the new verification checklist and documenting the storefront error/empty state behavior and admin products list expectations.
